data.name: Props_ParametersHint
data.value: Files dropped onto the icon replace {file} (one launch per file) or {files} (all at once); without a placeholder they are appended. {clipboard} inserts the clipboard text, {ask:Question} asks for a value. A value is refused when the program could run it as a command (a batch file, cmd.exe, WSL, Windows Terminal, the host for ssh; PowerShell script text and the command ssh or plink sends, where only letters, digits, spaces and . _ - \ / : pass) or take it as an option (it begins with “-” where an argument starts, with no “--” before it). Inside code for another program (python -c, node -e, bash -c), or an ssh option that holds a command or a file (-o, -F, -proxycmd, -m), a value is code: keep placeholders out of it.
